This is a template to reformat [[Special:Categories|Category]] tags so that they properly segment existing categories into version-specific areas using the page's namespace, and to properly organize them alphabetically by page name unless specified differently by the editor.<br>

'''Usage:'''<pre><nowiki>{{Category|Category Name|Sort}}</nowiki></pre>
